NOTICE: Northwind Outfitters Inc. is a fictional demo company. All names, policies, amounts, phone

units.verbatim_text: 20. Revision History and Sample Case Studies
Northwind Outfitters Inc. ("Northwind", "we", "us") is a fictional online and retail seller of outdoor gear,
apparel, camping equipment and accessories, headquartered in Portland, Oregon. This handbook
describes our policies on refunds, returns, exchanges and cancellations for purchases made through
northwind-demo.example, our mobile app, and our 42 retail stores.
Our guiding principle is simple: if you are not satisfied with your purchase, we want to make it right. This
document is intended for customers, support agents, and finance staff, so that every refund decision is
Retail customers purchasing for personal use in the United States, Canada, the UK and the EU.
Marketplace customers purchasing Northwind-fulfilled items from third-party sellers (see Section 14).
Business customers on standard accounts (custom contracts may override these terms).

3-5 business days after we receive and inspect the return

Where this handbook conflicts with applicable consumer protection law, the law prevails. Nothing in this
policy limits statutory rights, including the 14-day cooling-off right for EU and UK distance purchases.
Most items purchased from Northwind may be returned within 30 calendar days of the delivery date (or
purchase date for in-store sales) for a full refund of the item price, provided the item is in original condition.
Until January 31 of the following year
Returns without proof of purchase are accepted in-store only, for store credit at the lowest price the item
was sold in the last 90 days. A government-issued photo ID is required and scanned. A limit of three
receipt-less returns per customer per 12-month period applies.
Exchanges for a different size or colour are free of charge, including shipping both ways, when requested
within the return window and when the replacement item is in stock. If the replacement costs more, the
difference will be charged; if less, the difference will be refunded.
To be eligible for a refund, all of the following conditions must be met. Support agents must verify each
condition before approving a refund over $50.00.
The request is made within the applicable return window.
The item is in original condition: unused, unwashed, undamaged, with original tags attached.
The item is returned with all accessories, manuals, free gifts and original packaging where practical.
The order number or proof of purchase can be verified in our systems.
The item is not on the non-refundable list in Section 5.
A partial refund may be issued when an item shows signs of use beyond inspection, is missing parts, or is
returned without original packaging. Typical deductions are shown below.
Light wear or signs of use
Up to $100: Tier 1 agent may approve.
$100.01 - $500: Tier 2 agent or team lead approval required.
Over $500: Customer Experience Manager approval required.
Over $2,000: Finance Director approval and fraud review required.

Fuel canisters, bear spray, and other hazardous materials once opened or shipped.
Perishable goods such as freeze-dried meals past 14 days from delivery.
Installation, repair, and gear-fitting services already performed.
Items returned more than 90 days after delivery.
Hygiene, safety and legal regulations prevent us from restocking certain categories. For example, we
cannot resell opened pressurised canisters. Custom products are made specifically for the customer and
Even for non-refundable items, a full refund or replacement will be provided if the item arrives damaged, is
materially different from its description, or was shipped in error. Report these issues within 7 days of
Customers can start a return through any of the following channels. Online requests are fastest and
Sign in at northwind-demo.example/returns and select the order.
Choose the items to return and select a reason from the list.
Upload photos if the item is damaged or defective.
Choose a refund method: original payment, store credit (bonus 5%) or exchange.
Print the prepaid label (if eligible) or choose a QR-code drop-off at a partner location.
Call 1-800-555-0142 (Mon-Fri 8am-8pm PT, Sat 9am-5pm PT) or use live chat. Please have your order
number and email address ready. Agents will email your RMA and label within 1 hour.
Bring the item, packaging and receipt or order confirmation to any Northwind store. In-store refunds to the
original card are processed immediately; the bank may take 3-5 days to post the credit.
Refund timing depends on the stage of the process. The table below shows typical timelines. Business
days exclude weekends and US federal holidays.
Instantly online; up to 1 hour by phone
Credit card refund posted by bank
A customer ships a return on Monday, March 2. The package is delivered to our warehouse on Friday,
March 6. Inspection is completed Monday, March 9, and the refund is issued that day. The customer's
credit card statement shows the credit by Friday, March 13 at the latest.
If a refund has not appeared 10 business days after our confirmation email, please contact your bank first,
then contact us with the refund reference number (format: REF-2026-XXXXXX). We will provide an
Refunds are issued to the original form of payment whenever possible. This is required for fraud
prevention and by card network rules.
New gift card or store credit
Customers who choose store credit instead of a refund to the original payment method receive a 5%
bonus on the credit value, up to $25. For example, a $200 return becomes $210 in store credit. Bonus
credit cannot be applied retroactively once a refund has been issued to the card.
If the original card has been closed or replaced, the bank will normally still forward the credit to the new
card. If it is rejected, we will contact the customer by email within 5 business days to arrange store credit
Shipping costs are handled differently depending on the reason for return.
Large items such as kayaks, canoes and heavy tents ship via freight. Return freight for change-of-mind
returns is a flat $49.00, deducted from the refund. Freight pickups must be scheduled with our logistics
team at least 3 business days in advance.
Customers may use their own carrier. We recommend a tracked service with insurance, as Northwind is
not responsible for returns lost in transit. Reimbursement for carrier costs is limited to $12.00 and only for
approved defective returns, with a receipt.
Prepaid labels can be dropped at over 15,000 carrier locations and all Northwind stores. Keep the drop-off
receipt until your refund has been confirmed.
If your order arrives damaged, defective or incorrect, we will make it right with a replacement or a full
refund, including original shipping, at your choice.
Please report issues within 7 days of delivery for the fastest resolution. Reports up to 30 days are
accepted for visible defects; hidden defects fall under the warranty (Section 14).
Clear photos of the damaged item and the outer shipping box.
Photo of the shipping label showing the order and tracking number.
A short description of the issue.
Video evidence for electronic or mechanical failures (recommended).
Same item shipped with free expedited shipping
Item price plus shipping and tax
For damaged items valued under $40.00, we may issue a refund without requiring the item to be returned
("Keep It" policy), at the agent's discretion. This is limited to two instances per customer per year.
Orders can be cancelled at no cost before they ship. Once an order has shipped, it must be handled as a
Full refund if stopped, else return
We may cancel an order for reasons including stock errors, pricing errors, suspected fraud, or inability to
verify payment. In such cases, a full refund is issued automatically within 3 business days, and a 10%
discount code may be provided where the cancellation was due to our error.
If an item you purchased drops in price within 14 days of purchase, contact us for a one-time price
adjustment refund of the difference. Limited to one adjustment per order. Doorbuster, flash-sale and
Northwind offers the following subscriptions: Trailhead Box (monthly gear box, $39.00/month),
Northwind Rewards Plus ($49/year), and Gear Care Plan ($9.99/month).
Full refund if cancelled within 48 hours
of renewal and box not shipped
No refund for current month; cancel
Rewards Plus offers a 14-day free trial. If you cancel before the trial ends, you will not be charged. If you
forget to cancel and are charged, contact us within 7 days for a full refund of the first charge.
We send renewal reminders 7 days before annual renewals. If you did not receive a reminder due to an
invalid email address, we will treat the renewal as accidental and refund in full within 30 days.
Trailhead Box subscribers can pause for up to 3 months, once per year, from the account page. Paused
Digital goods such as trail guides (PDF), camping-skills video courses, and map packs are non-refundable
after download or streaming begins. If a file is corrupt or inaccessible, we will provide a working copy or a
full refund within 14 days of purchase.
Video courses may be refunded within 7 days if less than 20% of the content has been viewed.
Gift cards are not refundable for cash, except where required by law (e.g. California, balances under
Gift cards never expire and carry no fees.
Lost or stolen gift cards can be replaced if the card number is provided, minus any used balance.
Gift card purchases cannot be cancelled once the code is delivered by email.
Fraudulently purchased gift cards will be voided and the associated payment refunded to the real
Gift recipients can return items with a gift receipt for store credit equal to the price paid, or exchange for
another item. The purchaser is not notified of the return. Without a gift receipt, credit is issued at the
Promotional credits and coupon codes have no cash value. If an order paid with a promotional code is
refunded, the code's value is returned as promotional credit, not as cash.
A refund is a return of money for a purchase within the return window. A warranty claim addresses defects
that appear later, during normal use.

units.verbatim_text: Normal wear and tear, fading, and gradual abrasion.

units.verbatim_text: Damage from misuse, accidents, improper cleaning or storage.

units.verbatim_text: Modifications or repairs by unauthorised parties.

units.section: 14.1 What the warranty does not cover
units.verbatim_text: Damage from fire, flood, wildlife, or other external causes.
Items sold by third-party sellers but fulfilled by Northwind are covered by this policy. Items shipped directly
by third-party sellers follow the seller's policy, but Northwind's A-to-Z Guarantee ensures a refund if the
seller fails to respond within 5 business days.
Northwind ships to 38 countries. International returns follow the same eligibility rules, with the exceptions
Refunds are issued in the currency of the original charge. Exchange rate differences between the
purchase and refund date are not compensated; the bank's rate on the refund date applies. For example,
a EUR 100.00 purchase may be charged as $108.00 and refunded as $106.50 depending on exchange
Customers are responsible for filing customs duty drawback claims where available. Northwind will
provide a commercial invoice and proof of return upon request. Refused deliveries at customs are
refunded minus outbound and return shipping.
We encourage customers to contact us before initiating a chargeback with their bank. Most issues can be
resolved faster directly, and a chargeback can lead to account restrictions.
Customer files a dispute with the card issuer.
Our payment processor notifies us within 1-3 business days.
We submit evidence (order record, delivery confirmation, communications) within 7 days.
If the dispute is lost, funds are debited; a $15 administration fee may apply for fraudulent claims.

units.section: 16.2 If you already received a refund
units.verbatim_text: treated as potential fraud, and the customer is liable for repayment.
Northwind monitors return activity to protect honest customers and prevent abuse. Our systems and
agents look for patterns such as:
Return rates exceeding 40% of purchases across a rolling 12-month period.
Returning items that were not purchased from Northwind.
Wardrobing - purchasing items for one-time use and returning them.
Returning counterfeit or swapped items (e.g. an empty box, or a lower-grade item).
Multiple accounts linked to the same address, device or payment method.
Repeated claims of 'item not received' on delivered orders.
Return rate over 40% or one confirmed
Store credit only; returns need manager
Account closed; referral to law enforcement
Customers may appeal restrictions in writing to appeals@northwind-demo.example within 30 days.
Appeals are reviewed by a manager not involved in the original decision within 10 business days.
Return history is stored per our Privacy Policy, retained for 7 years for audit purposes, and never sold to
Q1. Can I return an item after 30 days?
Standard returns must be requested within 30 days. Gold members have 60 days. After that we may offer
store credit at a manager's discretion for unused items within 90 days.
Q2. Will I get my shipping cost back?
Only if the return is due to our error or a defect. For change-of-mind returns, original shipping is not
Q3. How will I know my refund has been issued?
You will receive an email titled 'Your refund is on the way' containing the refund amount, method, and
Q4. I returned my item but have not received a refund. What should I do?
Check your tracking to confirm delivery, allow 2 business days for inspection and up to 5 more for your
bank. If it has been more than 10 business days, contact support.
Q5. Can I return an item bought in-store through the website?
Yes. Items bought in-store can be returned in any store or by mail using the RMA process with your
Q6. Do sale items qualify for a refund?
Regular sale items yes; items marked Final Sale or Clearance - All Sales Final no.
Q7. Can I get a cash refund?
Refunds go to the original payment method. Cash refunds are only available for cash purchases under
Q8. What if my package was stolen after delivery?
Please file a police report and contact us within 14 days. We offer one courtesy replacement per customer
Q9. Is my sales tax refunded?
Yes, tax is refunded proportionally with the item price.
Q10. Can I cancel part of my order?
Yes, if the order has not shipped. Contact support to remove specific items.
Our customer care team is available through the following channels. All contact details below are fictional.
Level 1: Customer Care Agent - resolves most issues in one contact.
Level 2: Team Lead - refunds over $100, policy exceptions.
Level 3: Customer Experience Manager - refunds over $500, complex disputes.
Level 4: Executive Resolution Office - legal threats, regulatory complaints, media.

Case A - Wrong size, within window. Maria ordered a $120 jacket (order NW-10482391) and received it
on June 3. On June 20 she requested a return as it did not fit. She used the prepaid label ($6.95
deducted). Refund issued: $113.05 to her Visa, plus tax refunded proportionally.
Case B - Defective tent zipper. Daniel bought a $349 tent on May 1 and discovered a broken zipper on
May 12. He reported it with photos. Northwind issued a free label and sent a replacement tent with
expedited shipping. Total cost to customer: $0.
Case C - Late return, Gold member. Priya (Gold) returned a $79 pair of boots on day 52. Because Gold
members have 60 days, a full refund of $79 was issued with free return shipping.
Case D - Final Sale item. Tom attempted to return a $25 Final Sale fleece after 10 days. The request was
declined under Section 5. As a goodwill gesture, a 10% discount code was offered.
Case E - Subscription accident. Lena was charged $49 for Rewards Plus renewal on Feb 3 and
